proposed.explanation: Gyeongbokgung Palace is a Joseon Dynasty royal palace, not a Silla temple. Changdeokgung Palace is a Joseon Dynasty secondary palace, not a Silla temple. Namdaemun Gate is a Joseon city gate structure. Bulguksa Temple is explicitly identified as a Silla Dynasty temple (751 CE, completed 774) in Gyeongju with stone foundations and platforms, wooden structures, and pagodas (Dabotap and Seokgatap).
